title: Newsom Commutes the Sentences of California’s 548 Death Row Inmates
summary: Gov. Gavin Newsom, who is expected to run for president, called capital punishment morally objectionable. Though California hasn’t executed anyone for 20 years, that represents about a quarter of death sentences nationwide.
